## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 40-fascicle text by [法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Fǎhù (Dharmapāla, the Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau translator) and his team is the *Bodhisattva-piṭaka* (菩薩藏) — the Mahāyāna canonical collection on bodhisattva-path doctrine. The text was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition as one of its 49 assemblies and stands among the most substantial Northern-Sòng *Bǎojī*-tradition translation projects.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Fǎhù / Dharmapāla's Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau activity, c. 1004 – 1058 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. At 40 fascicles, the work is one of the most substantial Sòng Buddhist translation projects, paralleling the great Tang *[Bǎo jī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* and *[Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)* projects in scale.

The Taishō text (T0316) is established on the standard apparatus.
